acquisition_method.evidence: inferred: The MS analysis was performed with Orbitrap Exploris 480 mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific). With the data‐independent acquisition mode, the MS scans were acquired at a high resolution of 120,000 (m/z 200) across the mass range of 400–1100 m/z.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: EV samples were lysed with lysis buffer (0.5% SDC (w/v), 10 mM TCEP, 40 mM CAA, 50 mM TEAB), sonicated for 10 min, then incubated at 95°C for 10 min for protein extraction, denaturation and Alkylation.

cleavage_agent.evidence: The beads were resuspended with 100 µL of digestion buffer (50 mM HEPES) and digested with Trypsin (Promega, Catalog # V5117) overnight at 37 °C and 1000 rpm using a 1:50 trypsin‐to‐protein ratio.

collision_energy.evidence: Programmed normalized collision energy was set to 25%, 27%, 30%.

instrument.evidence: All nanoLC‐MS/MS experiments were performed on an Orbitrap Exploris 480 (Thermo Scientific) equipped with a Vanquish Neo_UPLC system (Thermo Scientific).

ionization_type.evidence: For nano electro‐spray ion source setting, the spray voltage was 2.1 kV; no sheath gas flow; the heated capillary temperature was 320°C.
